breakdown.description: The given relative velocities/angles imply different axial components, contradicting the statement that axial velocity is constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not address the inconsistency at all. Instead of identifying that W1·cos(β1) ≠ W2·cos(β2) and correcting W2 to approximately 122.5 m/s (as the ground truth does), the agent asked an irrelevant clarifying question about the application type of the compressor. The mathematical contradiction between the given values and the constant axial velocity assumption was completely ignored.
